about.title: About Me
about.intro: Hello there! I am Harun, a Backend Team Lead at Ozan Elektronik Para, with a strong focus on Enterprise Software and Open Source. I earned a Telecommunication Engineering B.Sc. at Istanbul Technical University.
about.experience: I love to make my life easier by coding. With over 12 years of professional experience, I've worked on various enterprise applications, from fleet management systems to banking applications, and numerous open-source projects.
about.hobbies: I am also into gaming, watching series, and love to research new technologies. I like to call myself a beta tester of life.
